title: 第12章 花苑小区
slug: 万界词条从基因锁词条开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“那瓶药剂，就在距离这里大约一公里外的花苑小区。”

玲玲来到窗外，伸手指向右前方的街道。

罗兰顺着方向看去，只见远处是一处高楼林立的小区，路上到处都是停摆的车辆和丧尸。

“当时，那里爆发了一场很激烈的战斗，但是战斗很快就结束了。”

玲玲说道：“而结束后，只有丧尸的嘶吼声，没有别的动静。”

“我弟弟没有找我，也没有任何联络，显然他们陷在了那里。”

罗兰注视着远处的小区，不过距离太远，一路上都是障碍，他也看不见小区附近有什么情况。

观察了片刻，尤其是着重观察一路上的丧尸分布情况后，罗兰便开口问道：“几天前，那三个枪手，你认识吗？他们会不会是官方的人？”

“不认识。”玲玲摇了摇头，说道：“不过我看到过他们从地下室出来寻找食物。”

“至于他们的自动步枪，不知道从什么地方得到的，或许，是从我弟弟他们身上得到的？”

玲玲也不太确定，因为自动步枪这种东西不容易弄到，如果是普通的手枪，或许还能从局子里搞到，但是自动步枪这种东西，是严格管控的。

除非是军队的人，否则其他人基本不可能得到这东西。

“既然如此，你之前为什么不让他们帮忙，反而现在让我帮忙？”罗兰注视着玲玲。

“他们有三个人，手里有三把枪，看上去年纪都有三十左右，一旦他们心怀不轨，对我们的威胁就太大了。”

玲玲毫不避讳，冷静的眼神直直看着罗兰：“但是你不一样，你只有一个人，而且看上去并不像是坏人。”

“以及，你在没有枪械的时候，实力就很不错。”

玲玲说道：“加上我们的食物不多，所以我就选择赌一把！”

罗兰闻言一笑，将刀枪收起，淡淡说道：“你很聪明，也很机智。”

“你赌对了，我对你们没有恶意，等一下我就带你们寻找食物。”

听到罗兰说的话，玲玲瞬间松了一口气。

“不过，事先说好，我帮你们寻找食物，而你们则要给我处理丧尸的大脑。”

罗兰说道：“如果你们不愿意处理丧尸大脑，到时候约定就作废。”

“没问题。”玲玲点头，神色凝重。

处理丧尸大脑，从里面寻找东西，对于她们几个人来说，是一件十分困难的事情。

不过，再困难也比去杀丧尸要强！

而且，只要她们克服心理障碍，处理丧尸大脑就是一件比较轻松的工作了。

Page (1/3)

"That bottle of potion is in the Huayuan Community about one kilometer away from here."

Lingling came to the window and pointed to the street ahead on the right.

Roland looked in the direction and saw a community with tall buildings in the distance. Parked vehicles and zombies were everywhere on the road.

"There was a fierce fight there, but it ended quickly."

Lingling said: "And after it was over, there was only the roar of zombies and no other movement."

"My brother didn't look for me or have any contact, so obviously they were stuck there."

Roland looked at the community in the distance, but the distance was too far, there were obstacles along the way, and he couldn't see what was going on near the community.

After observing for a moment, especially the distribution of zombies along the way, Roland asked: "Do you know those three gunmen a few days ago? Could they be official people?"

"I don't know them." Lingling shook her head and said, "But I have seen them coming out of the basement to look for food."

"As for their automatic rifles, I don't know where they got them. Maybe they got them from my brother and the others?"

Lingling is not sure, because automatic rifles are not easy to obtain. If it is an ordinary pistol, you may be able to get it from the bureau, but automatic rifles are strictly controlled.

Unless they are members of the military, it is basically impossible for others to obtain this thing.

"In that case, why didn't you let them help before, instead of letting me help now?" Roland looked at Lingling.

"There are three of them with three guns in their hands. They all look to be around thirty years old. Once they have evil intentions, they will pose a great threat to us."

Lingling did not shy away and looked directly at Roland with calm eyes: "But you are different. You are only one person, and you don't look like a bad person."

"And, you are very powerful when you don't have firearms."

Lingling said: "Besides, we don't have much food, so I chose to take a gamble!"

Roland smiled when he heard this, put away his sword and gun, and said calmly: "You are very smart and witty."

"You made the right bet. I have no ill intentions towards you. I will take you to find food later."

Hearing what Roland said, Lingling breathed a sigh of relief.

"However, we agreed in advance that I will help you find food, and you will help me deal with the zombie brains."

Roland said: "If you are not willing to deal with the zombie brains, the agreement will be void when the time comes."

"No problem." Lingling nodded, her expression solemn.

Dealing with zombie brains and finding things inside is a very difficult task for them.

However, no matter how difficult it is, it is still better than killing zombies!

Moreover, as long as they overcome their psychological barriers, dealing with zombie brains will be an easier task.
